name: LocalSend
description: 终极跨平台局域网隔空投送神器，iOS、Android、Windows、macOS、Linux 通用，无需注册登录，端到端加密极速传输文件与文字。
descriptionEn: An open-source cross-platform AirDrop alternative. Wirelessly share files and messages over local Wi-Fi with zero setup and E2EE encryption.
warningText: 完全开源免费！两台设备处于同一 Wi-Fi 或热点下即可秒连互传，不需要消耗外网流量，零隐私泄露风险。
warningTextEn: Fully FOSS and ad-free. Devices connect peer-to-peer over your local network without routing bytes through third-party cloud servers.

name: RustDesk
description: 开箱即用的开源远程桌面控制软件，完全替代 TeamViewer 和商业限制软件，支持官方公共服务器或单机器自建专属中继服务。
descriptionEn: The premier open-source remote desktop client. Replace TeamViewer/AnyDesk with full control over your data via public or self-hosted relays.
warningText: 官方免费版体验极佳无时长限制。若跨国/跨网段连接偶遇网络波动，推荐用百元 VPS 一键自建 RustDesk Server。
warningTextEn: No commercial session time limits. For low-latency cross-region connections, self-hosting a lightweight relay container is recommended.

name: Everything (Voidtools)
description: Windows 平台不可或缺的秒级文件名实时搜索引擎，几百万个文件键入即现，内存占用极小。
descriptionEn: Instant real-time file search engine for Windows. Locates files and folders by name among millions instantly with minimal memory usage.
warningText: 官网完全免费下载无广告。警惕搜索引擎前置的推广仿冒站点，一定要认准 voidtools.com 官方域名。
warningTextEn: Free from voidtools.com. Beware of lookalike ad-supported download mirrors on search engines.

name: Geek Uninstaller
description: 单文件免安装的 Windows 深度卸载神器，强制清理流氓软件卸载后残留的文件、空目录与注册表垃圾项。
descriptionEn: Fast, lightweight single-executable Windows uninstaller. Performs deep force scans for residual registry entries and leftover file junk.
warningText: 免费版（Free 版本）已满足日常所有深度卸载需求，无需购买 PRO 版，纯净无弹窗推广。
warningTextEn: The Free version covers all core forced removal needs with zero nag screens or bundled software.

name: Flow Launcher
description: Windows 下颜值与生态最强的开源快速启动器与全局搜索利器，数百款社区插件支持文件检索、计算器、网页直达与剪贴板历史。
descriptionEn: Quick file search & app launcher for Windows. Modern Raycast-like experience extensible with hundreds of community plugins.
warningText: 完全开源免费。配合 Everything 插件联动，可体验 Windows 上的终极生产力加速。
warningTextEn: Free and open-source. Pair with the built-in Everything plugin for lightning-fast system-wide indexing.

name: Ventoy
description: 装机神器，只需将 U 盘格式化一次 Ventoy，之后将各类 Windows/Linux/PE 的 ISO 镜像直接拷贝进 U 盘即可开机启动引导。
descriptionEn: The revolutionary bootable USB tool. Format a thumb drive once, then simply drop ISO/WIM/IMG files onto the drive to boot directly.
warningText: 纯开源装机神器。首次制作会格式化 U 盘，请务必提前备份好 U 盘内的个人数据！
warningTextEn: Open-source USB multi-boot tool. Formatting the drive during initial setup erases existing data, so backup files beforehand.
